title: current_claims_requiring_verification
evidence_scope: QA run 54451 (permission posture, headless only); QA run 58580 artifacts 44350, 44356, 44368 (Claude pickup; Codex and Cursor started after machine hooks existed); QA runs 58749 (artifacts 44547-44549) and 58750 (artifacts 44552-44555), one macOS 12 host each reset to fresh-host with no Yoke hooks before the harness started.
claim: Still unverified: real user/project hook merge/dedup. Permission modes and curl-pipe allowance were settled by QA run 54451 (headless yoke allowed, unapproved curl refused in each restrictive default mode). Mid-session pickup after an in-session install, 2026-10-24, macOS: Claude Code 2.1.310 registered on the next prompt with no restart (run 58580). Codex 0.164.0 (run 58749) and Cursor Agent 2026.08.25 (run 58750), each started with no Yoke hooks, never fired a hook in that session: two later turns failed session-hook-registration with SESSION_HOOK_UNOBSERVED and received no orientation. Sessions that machine hooks had already registered stayed projectless and failed with SESSION_HOOK_PROJECT_MISMATCH (run 58580). In every case a new session in the project folder registered on its first prompt, passed doctor run --session 3/3 and received exactly one orientation.
